About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

raw.title: Inbound Account Development Representative - France
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.title: Inbound Account Development Representative - France
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Own KIDAN's Cybersecurity Posture Own KIDAN's overall cybersecurity posture, strategy, policies, standards and roadmap. Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across KIDAN's technology, operations and internal environment. Identify and challenge cyber risks, gaps and priorities, and drive corrective actions. Own cybersecurity compliance and support certifications and frameworks such as ISO 27001. Work closely with Technology, Operations and leadership to ensure cybersecurity is built into how KIDAN operates. Be technically involved in assessing KIDAN's cybersecurity architecture, technologies, configurations, controls and implementations. Regularly go beyond governance and documentation to validate that cyber controls are actually implemented and working effectively in practice. 2. Provide Hands-On Technical Cybersecurity Leadership Act as a technical cybersecurity leader who can get into the field and work directly with technical teams. Review and challenge cybersecurity architectures, technical designs, configurations, implementations and controls. Participate directly in complex cyber investigations, incident response, escalations and technical problem-solving when required. Work alongside engineers, cybersecurity specialists and SOC analysts to solve complex cyber challenges and improve technical capabilities. Maintain a strong understanding of the technologies, tools and platforms used across KIDAN's cybersecurity environment. Be able to independently understand and assess technical cyber issues rather than relying exclusively on the team for technical interpretation. Set the technical standard for the cybersecurity organization and continuously raise the team's technical maturity. Remain sufficiently hands-on to maintain technical credibility with both internal teams and enterprise customers. 3. Own & Develop the Cybersecurity Offering Own the strategy, quality and relevance of KIDAN's cybersecurity offering. Continuously challenge and improve our cybersecurity services, capabilities and value proposition. Ensure our SOC and cybersecurity services (e.g. detection and response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, cyber resilience) are technically strong, operationally mature and aligned with enterprise customer needs. Stay close to the actual delivery of our cybersecurity services and understand how our offerings are implemented in real customer environments. Work with the commercial and technology teams to identify opportunities to grow KIDAN's cybersecurity business and revenue. Ensure what we sell is what we can genuinely deliver at a high standard. Participate in the design and evolution of cybersecurity solutions, architectures and service models. Support the team in complex technical customer opportunities where senior cybersecurity expertise is required. 4. Challenge Cybersecurity Delivery Ensure cybersecurity services and projects are delivered to a consistently high standard. Stay close to delivery and regularly engage with the teams doing the technical work. Challenge processes, technical decisions, architecture and delivery quality where cybersecurity standards are not met. Review technical deliverables and cybersecurity implementations where appropriate. Oversee the SOC team and ensure strong operational performance, processes, quality and continuous improvement. Establish clear cybersecurity KPIs, controls and quality standards. Step into critical delivery, technical escalations or cyber incidents when the situation requires senior technical expertise. Ensure lessons from cyber incidents, projects and customer engagements are translated into improvements across the cybersecurity function. 5. Enterprise Customer & Cybersecurity Escalation Point Act as a senior cybersecurity point of contact for key enterprise customers. Be comfortable going into customer environments and engaging directly with technical teams, cybersecurity teams, IT leaders and executives. Lead or support customer discussions around cybersecurity strategy, architecture, compliance, cyber risk and major requirements. Participate in technical workshops, cyber risk assessments, architecture discussions and complex customer engagements. Act as the escalation point for critical cybersecurity topics, incidents and customer concerns. Be able to discuss technical cybersecurity topics at depth with experienced customer cyber and IT professionals. Build trust with customers by bringing strong technical expertise, credibility and business understanding. 6. Cybersecurity Leadership & Governance Establish clear cybersecurity governance, ownership and decision-making across KIDAN. Ensure cyber risks are visible and appropriately escalated to leadership. Partner with Technology, Compliance, Operations and other functions on cybersecurity priorities and risk management. Lead, coach and develop the cybersecurity team, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement. Lead by technical credibility and expertise, not only through management and delegation. Stay current on relevant cyber threats, attacker techniques, technologies, regulations and industry standards, and translate them into actionable priorities for KIDAN. What Great Looks Like KIDAN has a strong, credible and continuously improving cybersecurity posture. Cybersecurity is not only documented and compliant. KIDAN's cybersecurity revenue grows because customers trust our expertise and see clear value in our offering. Enterprise customers know they have a senior, credible cybersecurity expert they can trust and escalate to. Cyber risks, incidents and compliance gaps are identified early and acted upon. Technology and cybersecurity teams work closely together, with cybersecurity embedded into how KIDAN builds and delivers technology Requirements Strong senior experience in cybersecurity, security operations or a CISO-level role. Strong understanding of cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk, compliance and security operations. Experience managing or leading a SOC / cyber defense function. Strong understanding of enterprise cybersecurity and cybersecurity service delivery. Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders. Strong ability to challenge technical and business decisions and communicate cyber risk clearly. Experience with ISO 27001 and relevant cybersecurity frameworks Fluent in French and English. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

Program Planning & Execution

  • Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
  • Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
  • Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
  • Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.

PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes

  • Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
  • Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
  • Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
  • Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.

Risk, Issue & Performance Management

  • Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
  • Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
  • Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
  • Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
  • Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
  • Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration

  • Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
  • Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
  • Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

  • Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

  • A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

  • Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.

  • Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus

  • Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

  • Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

  • Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

  • You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

  • You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations.

  • You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward.

  • You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation.

  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables.

  • You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company.

  • You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues.

  • You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs.

What We Offer

  • A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction.

  • The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth.

  • Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs.

  • The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter.

description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware. Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions. Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment. Candidates Requirements Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus. Technical skills : Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus. Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. As a Machine Learning Intern, you join the team to explore framed topics, assess their relevance and feasibility through proofs of concept, and help the strongest ideas reach production. You own your project end to end, from literature review and scoping to implementation and benchmarking, on topics shaped by live projects and production needs. You work in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, on cutting-edge research topics in an emerging defense company where the stakes are high. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship.

 
 

Responsibilities

  • Run literature reviews and state-of-the-art analyses on computer vision and machine learning topics framed by the team.

  • Scope projects, define tasks, and decide which approaches to benchmark, from baselines to the most prominent algorithms.

  • Build experimentation plans and define implementation architectures for novel approaches.

  • Collect, prepare, synthesize, and augment data for model training and evaluation.

  • Implement, train, and benchmark models across topics such as foundation models, knowledge distillation, CNNs, transformers, and embedded models.

  • Explore multi-sensor fusion and the processing of temporal data where projects call for it.

  • Evaluate results rigorously with task-specific metrics to judge relevance and feasibility.

  • Develop proofs of concept and support the transition of promising ones towards production.

  • Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects.

 
 

Candidate Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an MSc in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with ML projects involving model training and evaluation, ideally across different tasks and architectures such as CNNs and transformers.

  • Ability to select the best-performing model for a use case and to choose suitable task-specific evaluation metrics.

  • Familiarity with computer vision and image processing is a plus, such as classification, detection, tracking, segmentation, depth estimation, or 3D vision.

  • Awareness of model scale trade-offs, from large multi-GPU architectures to small optimized models on embedded platforms.

  • Motivated, autonomous, and proactive, with the ability to own a project and communicate results clearly.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p>As a Senior Sales Operations Manager, you will support the EMEA South Go-To-Market team as a trusted advisor to sales leaders, enabling consistent, predictable, and repeatable hyper-growth through sales discipline, streamlined processes, and a strong operating cadence. You will partner with the EMEA South Leadership Team on GTM design, business analysis, and metrics while managing the day-to-day rhythm of the business, with field productivity as your north star. This role is based in Amsterdam, Prague, or Milan, and is ideal for someone who wants to be an active voice driving change rather than a passive spectator.</p> <h3>What Will You Do?</h3> <p>Primary responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Serve as the EMEA South Operations Lead and trusted advisor to key sales leaders, actively participating in the EMEA forecasting process, advising on changing pipeline dynamics, and challenging forecasts to ensure accuracy, predictability, and transparency.</li> <li>Manage Area business metrics including performance, trends, headcount, and investment models, and lead the development of key sales metrics and business review materials, monitoring performance and taking action to optimize business results.</li> <li>Drive the annual sales planning process, including Area, Regional, and District goal assignments, territory management updates, and sales compensation plan changes.</li> <li>Identify gaps in the infrastructure needed to support Sales and develop solutions, with a strong focus on AI, that align to the team’s overall vision, while educating and training teams on key sales processes.</li> <li>Act as an active voice that drives change with Area leadership, and align with the Global Revenue Operations team to represent the needs of the field.</li> </ul> <h3>What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?</h3> <p>Ideal candidates will have:</p> <ul> <li>7 to 10 years of experience in Sales, Revenue, or Field Operations supporting sales teams, with a strong emphasis on enabling teams to be hyper-productive, ideally within organizations selling subscription security software.</li> <li>Experience designing and scaling processes that support a hyper-growth business model, including documenting key processes in a publicly traded environment.</li> <li>Proven analytical ability to turn disparate datasets into insightful analytics, including developing messaging, data visualizations, and executive-level presentations.</li> <li>Solid experience with a key tech stack including Salesforce, Clari, Tableau, MS Office, G-Suite, and AI tools.</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence sales teams, build collaborative relationships across functions, and translate the complex needs of the field. A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Management, Technology, or Economics is required, and an MBA is a plus.</li> </ul> <h3>Why SentinelOne?</h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity &amp; Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off &amp; Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance &amp; Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Insurance and medical allowance</li> <li>Pension scheme</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks &amp; Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Commuter or work-from-home allowance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellness &amp; Lifestyle</strong></p> <ul> <li>Wellness benefit</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.&nbsp;</span></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our&nbsp;<a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt53c99b43892c2378/bltca86b3b84e902400/AI-in-Hiring-SentinelOne.pdf">AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Group Finance Contractor
description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow — with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 1,000+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact We're looking for an experienced Finance Contractor to join our Accounting team for an initial 6–9 month period. You'll help keep the wheels turning on our day to day accounting, supporting the monthly and yearly close process, while also bringing a fresh pair of eyes to how we can do things better. This is a hands-on, broad remit. You'll pitch in wherever the team needs support, from general ledger and reconciliations to month end deliverables, and you'll have the chance to help us tighten up processes and controls along the way. Jouw impact bij Movares

Jouw advies voorkomt dat hoogspanningsverbindingen risico’s voor de omgeving veroorzaken. Zo maak jij de uitbreiding van het Nederlandse energienet veilig en verantwoord mogelijk.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je adviseert toonaangevende opdrachtgevers over complexe elektromagnetische beïnvloeding rond hoogspanningsverbindingen.

  • Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise zichtbaar in te zetten, bijvoorbeeld bij klanten en binnen normcommissies.

Als senior adviseur EMC overzie je complexe vraagstukken rond elektromagnetische beïnvloeding. Je beoordeelt welke normen van toepassing zijn, doorziet vroegtijdig de gevolgen voor assets van derden en adviseert over passende maatregelen. Je kijkt verder dan afzonderlijke berekeningen, waarbij je project overstijgende risico’s signaleert, de scope afbakent en klanten helpt weloverwogen keuzes te maken. Je werkt voor onder meer netbeheerders, infrabeheerders en eigenaren van kabels en leidingen.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je combineert diepgaande technische kennis met overtuigende adviesvaardigheden. title: Backend Software Developer
description: Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer . Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers. Jouw rol Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions). Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation). Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging. Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden. Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties . Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen. Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation . Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre . Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie : Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact : De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper). Salaris : Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen : 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten. Werkplek & Sfeer : Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen. Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding. Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies. De 'Gadget Kit' : Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek. Events & Fun : Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast . Solliciteren Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 . Have a great day. Dawn Technology. We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. title: Interim Senior Community Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.   With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.   Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.   We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.   What you’ll be doing You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline. The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues. You’ll be: Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline. Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch. Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers. Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand. Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social. Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them. Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off. Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts. What we’re looking for Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you. 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch. Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs. You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow. A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it. Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR. A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams. Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract. A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures. Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.    Curious to apply? Apply directly through our careers page .   We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.   If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.   To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.   In the meantime If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?   Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at   While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com .   • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

  • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

  • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

  • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

description: We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors. As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers. We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them. Our Tech Stack At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.   Your role In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture. Delivery : Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience.  Direction : Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose. Talent : Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent. Culture : Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture. Craft : Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends. AI-first engineering : Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.   Your profile 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures. Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams. Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design. Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work. Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.   What's in it for you Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum! Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days). Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year! 1,000 EUR personal development budget. Complete coverage for commuting. Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup. Gym membership discount with Wellhub. Dutch/English classes budget. Variable pension scheme. Diverse international community (46+ nationalities). Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre.  Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday. description: Amsterdam  – Wil jij ontdekken hoe een tijdschriftredactie werkt, van eerste idee tot een verhaal in print én online? En lijkt het je leuk om mee te denken én te werken aan rubrieken en artikelen in Libelle? Dan hebben wij misschien wel een plek voor jou op de human interest-redactie. Op de human interest-redactie maken we de journalistieke producties voor Libelle. Denk aan de interviews met BN’ers, persoonlijke verhalen, vaste rubrieken zoals De dag nadat en Hoe het begon, columns en de verhalen over psychologie, gezondheid, maatschappij en werk & geld. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt mee aan vaste rubrieken in Libelle (bijv. In gesprek met Libelle, De Denktank, Hoe het begon) Je neemt zelf interviews af voor rubrieken in print en mogelijk ook online. Je bedenkt onderwerpen die aansluiten bij de doelgroep en pitcht ideeën voor de HI-planning. Je ondersteunt de human interest-redactie (de redactiemanager, coördinator en producer) bij de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Het gaat om een fulltime stage (32 tot 40 uur) per februari 2027. Wil je op een later moment stagelopen? Reageer vooral, dan kijken we vast naar de mogelijkheden. De stagiair die wij zoeken: Volgt een relevante HBO- of universitaire opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Journalistiek of Creative Business). Beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend en schrijft foutloos. Weet wat er speelt. Is een creatieve schrijver. Kan makkelijk schakelen tussen print en online. Heeft affiniteit met de doelgroep van Libelle. Heeft een proactieve houding. Is vanaf februari voor 5 á 6 maanden beschikbaar en minimaal 3 dagen per week. Wat krijg je van ons? ● Een leuke omgeving, goede begeleiding, borrels en de gezelligste collega’s. ● Een unieke stage om ervaring op te doen. ● Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van €400,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband. ● En een laptop van de zaak. Stagelopen bij DPG Media Stagelopen bij DPG Media betekent niet alleen dat je de door jou geleerde theorie in de praktijk brengt door een bijdrage te leveren aan onze ambitieuze teams, ook ga je bij ons écht wat leren. Een aanvulling ben je zeker, want jouw creatieve en frisse blik wordt erg gewaardeerd. Na je stage kan je zeggen dat je ook nog eens écht toffe dingen hebt bereikt én hebt gewerkt bij het grootste mediabedrijf van Nederland. Zet dat maar op je cv! Over DPG Media DPG Media heeft met haar sterke merken een stevige marktpositie in alle onderdelen van de mediabranche. Elke dag werken we met ontzettend veel plezier aan ons portfolio dat bestaat uit uiteenlopende A-merken, waaronder AD, AutoWeek, DonaldDuck, Libelle, Margriet, Linda, NU.nl , Qmusic, vtwonen en RTL. Je wordt dus onderdeel van een groter geheel: met al onze merken bereiken we elke maand 98% van de Nederlanders. Hoe tof is dat? Interesse, en dan? Heb je direct zin om aan de slag te gaan? Challenge cost and effort and make the make-or-buy call per subsystem.</li> <li>Work closely with the System Software Architect on the hardware/software split, real-time control, and safety architecture.</li> <li>Drive the hardware contribution to risk management (ISO 14971), including design FMEA and risk control measures.</li> <li>Plan and lead hardware verification, pre-compliance and and an employee stock option plan.</li> <li>A lean, senior team with short decision paths.</li> </ul> <h3 data-section-id="1pw1999" data-start="3755" data-end="3777"><strong data-start="3758" title: Platform Engineer
description: Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer . Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform. Jouw rol Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten. Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting. Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties. Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden. Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht. Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform. Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.   Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen.
